courses.summary: 帕亞拉是蓋亞那浮式開發案例；教學著重新增生產中心與區域物流、維修及量測的協同。本課依序分析區域維修資源共享、出貨批次與庫存峰值、處理設備液體庫存、輔助系統電力帳、共同時間窗計量，每項都包含可重算模型、證據規劃、故障辨析與驗收成果。數字全部是教學假設；不宣稱本案例採用這些設備參數。
courses.summaryEn: Payara is a Guyanese floating development; teaching examines coordination of a production centre with regional logistics and metering. The course analyses sharing regional maintenance resources, cargo batches and inventory peaks, liquid inventory in processing equipment, auxiliary-system electricity account, metering over common intervals, with recalculable models, evidence plans, fault discrimination and acceptance artifacts. All numbers are teaching assumptions; no plant-specific parameter is asserted.
